# RadarChart

Full-layout radar/spider chart composing **ChartHeader**, **ChartLegend**, standalone **DataDisplay**, **RadarGroup** D3 visualisation, and **ChartFooter** into a single accessible component.

Accepts single-series `ChartDataPoint[]` or multi-series `ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` (up to 4 series). Series colors resolve from `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n})` tokens emitted by `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`. No hard-coded visual values; no `modes` prop.

---

## Import

```tsx
import { RadarChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
// Types (tree-shaken, zero bundle cost)
import type {
  RadarChartProps,
  RadarGroupConfig,
  RadarChartDataDisplayConfig,
  RadarSeries,
  RadarPointHoverData,
  RadarHoverType,
  RadarYAxisConfig,
  ChartLegendItem,
  ChartDataPoint,
  ChartSeriesDataPoint,
} from '@oneui/datavis';
```

---

## Props

### Layer 2 — Chart-level

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `data` | `ChartDataPoint[] \| ChartSeriesDataPoint[]` | `[]` | Chart data — flat (single-series) or canonical (multi-series) format. |
| `seriesOrder` | `string[]` | auto | Explicit ordering of series names for legend and render order. |
| `width` | `number \| string` | `420` | Container width. Overridden by `fullWidth`. |
| `height` | `number \| string` | `'auto'` | Container height. When set, `RadarGroup` fills remaining space. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch container to `100%` of the parent. Overrides `width`. |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the ChartHeader (title + subtitle). |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the ChartFooter (source / note annotations). |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the categorical legend. |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a standalone DataDisplay above the radar. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `false` | Animate radar paths on mount via `useEntryAnimation`. |

### Layer 3 — Child component configurations

| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `chartHeaderConfig` | `ChartHeaderConfig` | `{ chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue, subtitle }` forwarded to ChartHeader. |
| `chartLegendConfig` | `ChartLegendConfig` | `{ items?, categoryLabelValue?, type? }` — manual items override auto-generation. |
| `dataDisplayConfig` | `Omit<DataDisplayProps, 'id'>` | Full DataDisplay API minus `id` (managed by `useChartAccessibility`). |
| `radarGroupConfig` | `RadarGroupConfig` | `{ gridLineNumber, maxValue, showAxisLabels, interactive, hoverType, hoverBadge, yAxis, yAxisConfig, valueFormat, onPointHover, curveStyle }` forwarded to RadarGroup. `valueFormat` also drives the hover ARIA live-text announcement. |
| `chartFooterConfig` | `ChartFooterConfig` | `{ annotationLeft, annotationLeftValue, annotationRight, annotationRightValue }` forwarded to ChartFooter. |

### Accessibility

| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | `{ ariaLabel, summary, dataTable, enabled }` — wraps the chart in a `role="figure"` container with `aria-label`, a visually-hidden summary paragraph, and an optional hidden data table for screen readers. All fields are optional. |

Full `AccessibilityConfig` shape:

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | auto (chart title) | Custom `aria-label` for the chart container. |
| `summary` | `string` | auto-generated | Overrides the auto-generated summary text read by screen readers. |
| `dataTable` | `boolean` | `true` | Render a visually-hidden data table for screen readers. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Master switch — set to `false` to disable all accessibility wrappers. |

---

## Design Tokens

All visual values are CSS custom properties resolved from the live cascade. No hard-coded values.

| Token | Sourced From | Description |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| `--RadarChart-containerGap` | Component override hook | Per-instance gap between sub-components. Fallback: `--Spacing-5`. |
| `--Spacing-5` | `@layer base` system token | Default container gap (dimension scale derived, ≈ 20 px). |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1..n}` | `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand :root` | Series path and legend colors. Resolved at paint time. |
| `--Label-S-FontSize`, `--Label-S-LineHeight` | `@layer brand` typography tokens | Axis and legend labels. |
| `--Stroke-XS`, `--Stroke-M` | `@layer base` system tokens | Grid line and axis line widths. |
| `--Neutral-Stroke-Low`, `--Neutral-Stroke-Medium` | `@layer brand` | Grid circle and spoke strokes. |
| `--Motion-Duration-L`, `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate` | `@layer base` motion tokens | Entry animation timing. |

---

## Data Formats

### Single-series (flat)

```tsx
const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Efficiency',  value: 85 },
  { category: 'Stability',   value: 60 },
  { category: 'Readiness',   value: 35 },
  { category: 'Reliability', value: 70 },
  { category: 'Agility',     value: 55 },
];
```

Internally wrapped as `[{ name: 'Series 1', data }]` before being passed to `RadarGroup`.

### Multi-series (canonical)

```tsx
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Efficiency',  series: 'Team A', value: 85 },
  { category: 'Stability',   series: 'Team A', value: 60 },
  // … more Team A points …
  { category: 'Efficiency',  series: 'Team B', value: 70 },
  // … more Team B points …
];
```

Series are extracted in discovery order unless `seriesOrder` is supplied.

---

## Usage Examples

### Minimal

```tsx
import { RadarChart } from '@oneui/datavis';

<RadarChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Efficiency',  value: 85 },
    { category: 'Stability',   value: 60 },
    { category: 'Readiness',   value: 35 },
    { category: 'Reliability', value: 70 },
    { category: 'Agility',     value: 55 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Performance Overview' }}
/>
```

### Multi-series with legend

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Team Comparison' }}
  radarGroupConfig={{ gridLineNumber: 4, hoverType: 'categorical' }}
/>
```

### With standalone DataDisplay

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={singleSeriesData}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Performance' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mainLabelValue: 'Overall Score',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '85' },
  }}
/>
```

### Full composition

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  chartHeader
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartFooter
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Team Performance', subtitle: true }}
  chartLegendConfig={{ type: 'line' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{ mainLabelValue: 'Avg', dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '72' } }}
  radarGroupConfig={{ gridLineNumber: 4, hoverType: 'individual', hoverBadge: true }}
  chartFooterConfig={{ annotationLeft: true, annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Jio.' }}
/>
```

### Full width

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  fullWidth
  chartHeader
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Full Width Radar' }}
/>
```

### Animated

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={singleSeriesData}
  animated
  chartHeader
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Animated Entry' }}
/>
```

Swap data between datasets to observe `useDataTransition` interpolation:

```tsx
const [dataset, setDataset] = useState<'a' | 'b'>('a');
const [key, setKey] = useState(0);

<RadarChart
  key={key}            // remount to replay entry animation
  data={dataset === 'a' ? dataA : dataB}
  animated
/>
```

### With accessibility config

```tsx
<RadarChart
  data={multiSeriesData}
  accessibility={{
    ariaLabel: 'Radar chart comparing Team A and Team B across five dimensions.',
    summary: 'Team A leads in Efficiency (85) and Reliability (70). Team B leads in Agility (90).',
    dataTable: true,   // default — renders a visually-hidden table for screen readers
  }}
/>
```

---

## Architecture

```
RadarChart
├── ChartAccessibility     — role="figure" + aria-label + live region
├── ChartHeader            — title + subtitle
├── ChartLegend            — categorical legend (auto-generated or manual)
├── DataDisplay            — standalone KPI display (optional)
├── div[data-name="radarWrapper"]
│   └── RadarGroup         — D3 radar / spider chart (paths, grid, labels, hover)
└── ChartFooter            — source / note annotations
```

### Token flow

```
generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection
  ↓ injected into :root at @layer brand
  --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1 … N

useBrandCSSNew
  ↓ injected into :root / [data-surface] at @layer brand
  --Spacing-* / --Label-*-FontSize / --Stroke-* / --Motion-*
```

`RadarChart.module.css` handles only structural layout (`.container` gap). All visual values remain in the CSS cascade.

---

## Series Colors

`RadarChart` does not accept a `color` prop directly. Colors resolve from CSS variables at paint time:

```
Series 1 → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)
Series 2 → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)
…
Series N → var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-N)
```

Override per-instance:

```css
.myChart {
  --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1: oklch(60% 0.18 250);
  --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2: oklch(55% 0.22 30);
}
```

Per-point color override is possible via `ChartDataPoint.color` / `ChartSeriesDataPoint.color`. These are passed through to `RadarGroup` and used directly as the SVG `stroke` value.

---

## Hover Badge

When `radarGroupConfig.hoverBadge={true}`, the RadarGroup renders a floating `Badge` component on hover. The badge text shows either:

- **individual mode** — the numeric value at the hovered point
- **categorical mode** — the hovered series name

The badge uses **quadrant-aware positioning**: based on the cursor's position relative to the chart center, the badge translates to the opposite quadrant so it never overflows the chart boundary.

---

## Animations

### Entry animation (`animated={true}`)

Uses `useEntryAnimation` to phase-in each radar path via `pathLength` / `strokeDasharray` / `strokeDashoffset`. Timing tokens:

| Token | Usage |
|-------|-------|
| `--Motion-Duration-L` | Total animation duration per series |
| `--Motion-Easing-Entrance-Moderate` | Easing function for entry |

### Data transition

When the `series` array changes (dataset switch), `useDataTransition` interpolates between old and new values using a custom `requestAnimationFrame` loop before re-rendering.

---

## Extending the Container Gap

Override the gap between header, legend, DataDisplay, radar, and footer per-instance:

```css
/* Component-level override */
.mySpecialChart {
  --RadarChart-containerGap: var(--Spacing-7);
}
```

No class extension or prop drilling required — the CSS variable is consumed directly in `RadarChart.module.css`.
